name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
aliases: the plane of light and shadow
description: The dual plane where Tam and her classmates are lured.

timeline.summary: Ashling begins a pilgrimage through Lorwyn, searching for the greater elemental of her birth.
timeline.quote: In 4520 AR , Ashling journeyed on a pilgrimage through Lorwyn

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The faeries of Lorwyn are largely unaffected by the Great Aurora, though Oona's consolidation of power leads some to branch into white.
timeline.quote: The faeries of Lorwyn were the only tribe to be largely unaffected by the Great Aurora

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona uses the Great Aurora to control the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle, alternating it every 300 years.
timeline.quote: used the Great Aurora to grant herself control of the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the cycle, and Oona fears she may be affected by the Great Aurora.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted in 4520 after the Great Mending

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds Rhys to her, granting him immortality.
timeline.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys, granting him immortality

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona deploys the second heir, who will become Maralen, into Lorwyn as the Great Aurora nears.
timeline.quote: As the Great Aroura neared, Oona deployed this second heir into Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is demoted after his ambush on a boggart party fails, and Gryffid takes command of the Hemlock pack.
timeline.quote: command of the Hemlock pack was handed over to his friend Gryffid

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Demotion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is branded kin-slayer, traitor and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid.
timeline.quote: he was soon to be branded "kin-slayer", traitor, and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling ascends a step on the Path of Flame, able to will her flame white, and leaves in flame with the elemental after helping free the giants.
timeline.quote: she also ascended a step on the Path of Flame, being able to will her red flame to a white one

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Abused and angry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling resolves to claim the elemental's power for herself rather than seek its guidance.
timeline.quote: instead to claim its power, fully, for herself

citation.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique find Rhys with a message from Colfenor.
timeline.quote: the flamekin carried a message for him

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn gives way to Shadowmoor and Ashling becomes one of its mightiest beings.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn gave place to the dreadful Shadowmoor, with Ashling becoming one of the mightiest beings on it.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Shadowmoor Ashling becomes the Extinguisher, called the Destroyer, worshiped and scorned by the cinders.
timeline.quote: Ashling became the Extinguisher , also known as the "Destroyer" to the other races.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling lays waste to many places but is repelled from Mistmeadow and Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Ashling laid waste to many places in Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
timeline.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reduced to a flamekin again, Ashling repents and helps Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: repented for her actions and tried to atone by helping Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Pendulum Year begins as the plane fuses and pockets of Lorwyn sprout in Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Pendulum Year". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge to control the plane's auroras, bringing forty years of peace.
timeline.quote: The twin worldsoul of the plane had emerged again to control the ebb and flow of the plane's auroras

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Pendulum Year". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona orders the death of Oko's father-figure; Oko vanishes vowing never to forgive her.
timeline.quote: Oona ordered the death of her progeny's newfound father-figure

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen returns to her companions unaware she travels with Oona's spies, and conflict grows between her and Oona.
timeline.quote: the insuppressible autonomy of Maralen quickly led to unresolved conflict between the two

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 4522 Ashling ventures to the Primal Beyond to better understand the plane's duality.
timeline.quote: Around 4522, she ventured to the Primal Beyond at the edge of Lorwyn

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling, now free of her Destroyer persona, becomes a rimekin in Shadowmoor and can keep those near her in Lorwyn form.
timeline.quote: she now became a rimekin when entering Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen succeeded in temporarily stealing Ashling’s power for herself.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona's death collapses the artificial cycles, and the plane enters the Pendulum Year before Eirdu and Isilu restore balance.
timeline.quote: the plane entered what would be recorded as the Pendulum Year .

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique, the elven monarchs and countless fae and elves perish; Ashling is freed of her madness and Maralen becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Maralen stood triumphant as the world's new queen of the fae.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR faeries slaughter a Mornsong wedding convoy.
timeline.quote: In 4520 AR , a group of faeries descended on a Mornsong wedding convoy and slaughtered them all.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen as she picks moonglove and replaces her with a faerie duplicate.
timeline.quote: An elf named Maralen was singled out and killed by Oona as she unsuspectingly picked moonglove .

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen meets Rhys in the Porringer Valley after his poison magic devastated the forest, and he agrees to take her toward Lys Alana.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, he agreed to take her to the Gilt-Leaf capital, Lys Alana .

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique takes Maralen directly to Oona after failing to read her mind.
timeline.quote: took her then directly to Oona

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After her audience with Oona, Maralen conjures fae magic to vanish Gilt-Leaf troops and watches Colfenor die and his sapling be born.
timeline.quote: She then went on to observe the fiery death of Colfenor and the subsequent birth of his sapling

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen comes to understand she is a fae duplicate created by Oona to carry her essence into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: She was a fae duplicate created by Oona to bear her memories and essence into the coming darkness of Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sharing Rosheen's dreamscape, Maralen decides to defy Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen awoke, freshly determined to defy the queen and greet the uncertain new world to do so.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen manipulates Endry into planting a faerie ring on the sapling to siphon the power of Ashling's ritual.
timeline.quote: She had manipulated Endry into planting a faerie ring of mushrooms on the sapling

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen obtains Rosheen's scroll after helping Jack Chierdagh divert a giant from Mistmeadow.
timeline.quote: The first, a scroll belonging to Rosheen, came into her possession after she and the siblings helped Jack Chierdagh divert the giant

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen is revealed to be a twin of Oona, defies her, and takes the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli.
timeline.quote: Later, she took the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli and challenged Oona to face her in a direct fight.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen gives Rhys a moonglove flower to use on her if Oona returns through her, and Rhys becomes unable to die until then.
timeline.quote: until that day came, Rhys could never die

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reemerge after the final Great Aurora to control the plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: They reemerged after the final Great Aurora to control the Plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor .

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor is announced as receiving a revisit set.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor was announced as receiving a revisit set

citation.text: "Rabiah Scale", section "Notes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona captures the giant Oko called father and has him publicly executed.
timeline.quote: Oona captured the giant Oko called "father" and had him publicly executed.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko leaves his home plane, intending never to return.
timeline.quote: he seized the opportunity to leave the plane, intending never to return

citation.text: "Oko", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko lures Sanar, Abigale, Kirol and Tamira through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor while they collect flowers at Harrier's Wood.
timeline.quote: the faerie planeswalker Oko appeared and lured Sanar

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The students accidentally wake Isilu in a chamber beyond carvings, and darkness floods the world.
timeline.quote: accidentally woke it

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid Baeli meets the students and offers them hospitality as the night erases their Omenpath.
timeline.quote: the kithkin offered them hospitality

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group finds Ashling at the Stinkdrinker warren and sets out to track Isilu, but is halted by Brigid and the Shadowmoor kithkin.
timeline.quote: The four set out to track down Isilu

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn elves attack Isilu, kithkin join the fight, and Maralen and Tamira are poisoned with moonglow.
timeline.quote: Maralen and Tamira were injured with the deadly poison moonglow

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives with Kirol, and Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen steal the dawnglow vial, saving Maralen and Tamira.
timeline.quote: snuck into the elven lines, stole the vial, and brought it back, saving Maralen and Tamira's lives

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Abigale returns with Eirdu, and the two gods embrace, restoring balance.
timeline.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Oona's control broken, Eirdu and Isilu reawaken and the day-night cycle begins to merge again.
timeline.quote: Eirdu and Isilu, were reawakened as the twin aspects of the plane began to merge once more

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Forty years later Oko returns and Maralen fears Oona's return; the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
timeline.quote: The siblings, rejoined for the first time in decades, reconciled in the presence of Eirdu and Isilu

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona contacts her grandchild Kellan worlds away and beckons him to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: She beckoned him to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and finds Maralen ruling Glen Elendra, plotting a trick that draws Strixhaven students there.
timeline.quote: he found Maralen ruling over Glen Elendra

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The students prematurely awaken Isilu, spreading Shadowmoor unnaturally.
timeline.quote: The students prematurely awakened Isilu

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she is Oko's sister, an avatar of Oona who rebelled and destroyed her.
timeline.quote: She then revealed that she was his sister, another avatar of Oona who had rebelled and destroyed her.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko protects Maralen and the students from elves, but Rhys wounds Maralen with a moonglow dagger.
timeline.quote: He was unable, however, to stop Maralen's retainer Rhys from wounding her

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko helps rout the elves, steals dawnglow and heals Maralen, then embraces her and reconsiders family.
timeline.quote: administered it to Maralen himself, which saved her from imminent death

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani rescues Kirol from Morcant's forces on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: Ajani separated Kirol from the elven forces

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Strixhaven advisorship". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani saves the poisoned Tamira with dawnglow.
timeline.quote: Ajani worked healing magic, saving Tamira with the help of dawnglow retrieved by Kirol

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Strixhaven advisorship". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated and destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling leaves the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
timeline.quote: the queen and mother of all faeries, Oona, had been defeated and destroyed, and her control over the cycle of day and night had ended.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
timeline.quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament as the aspects merge.
timeline.quote: two great beings awoke from the firmament above the plane: Eirdu, the incarnation of the sun, and Isilu, the incarnation of the moon.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Eclipsed realms begin to appear, as tales emerge of places caught between light and darkness.
timeline.quote: These areas came to be known as eclipsed realms.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The students land in an unfamiliar meadow of spiral-patterned flowers and floating stones and realize from the single sun that they are not on Arcavios.
timeline.quote: "Not on Arcavios," said Tam.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale stops Tamira from touching a stone and refuses to leave the others to fly up for help.
timeline.quote: I'm not leaving you here.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The darkness floods the meadow, turning day to night and transforming the landscape.
timeline.quote: the sky overhead erupted in stars, the sun becoming a thin eclipse ring of fire in the distance while the moon sprang to sudden, total fullness.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The blue faerie is transformed by the darkness into a green, gold-flecked, vaguely regal creature and flies off following the dark.
timeline.quote: Most striking of all, the blue bled out of its carapace, replaced by gleaming, gold-flecked green.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The darkness pours out of the dolmen gate, followed by distant screams.
timeline.quote: All that remained was the dark flowing out of the dolmen gate, and the distant sound of screams.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Elves advance on Maralen's party as the kithkin form a united wall and Isilu draws near with the faerie.
timeline.quote: The night-touched kithkin continued to ready their weapons and adjust their positions

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen greets the faerie as her brother, but it flits back to Isilu.
timeline.quote: You came home!

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu lowers its head to Ashling and begins circling the party protectively against the elves.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains that her brother was made a shapeshifter and the blue faerie was his Lorwyn self.
timeline.quote: The blue faerie that accompanied us was his Lorwyn self, and unfamiliar to me.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling reveals the elf torches hold captive sunlight elementals.
timeline.quote: Chained and captive and carried into night.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The elves charge and join battle with the kithkin.
timeline.quote: Then, with a peal of silvered bells, they surged forward and joined the battle.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kithkin arrows knock reliquaries from elves, freeing the sunlight elementals and transforming the elves into their Shadowmoor selves.
timeline.quote: gasped and changed, flesh and bone melting smoothly into their Shadowmoor selves.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar hits an elf archer with a rock and defiantly tells the elves to back off.
timeline.quote: We just want to go home

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A disarmed elf becomes a Shadowmoor elf and defects, prompting Brigid and the kithkin to charge.
timeline.quote: Brigid seemed to take her defection as a cue

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Tam is shot in the abdomen with an arrow and falls.
timeline.quote: an arrow protruding from her abdomen.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys approaches Maralen with a poisoned dagger, calling her Oona.
timeline.quote: I made your heir a promise. I made my friend a promise. This ends now.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys cuts Maralen's arm; she bleeds petals and collapses, and Rhys is stunned that she did not fight back.
timeline.quote: the wound bled petals in place of blood

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The faerie drops to the ground, grows into a tall winged man and confronts Rhys, declaring Oona dead and Maralen his sister.
timeline.quote: Oona is dead. Maralen was my sister

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar deduces the man is Maralen's brother, whom Oona made and threw away, while treating Tam's wound.
timeline.quote: You're Maralen's brother, the one who left before she was Maralen.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko recounts leaving Oona and mistaking Maralen for Oona reborn, and Rhys learns the poison has sealed her fate.
timeline.quote: His knife was coated in moonglow.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
